case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70610.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
sup:70610.subject: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
sup:70610.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

sup:70610.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
sup:70610.body:
Dear Franz Stadler,

Thank you for your quote; we have reviewed it and propose the terms below.

We commit to a binding volume of 30000 pieces a year over 24 months, our full need for this part, as in our demand forecast (fc:360030@2026-09).
Producer prices DE: fasteners and screw machine products (PPI-C2594) changed -1.6% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C2594@2024-10, idx:PPI-C2594@2025-10).
Your on-time delivery averaged 88.6% over the last two scorecard quarters (sc:70610@2026Q2, sc:70610@2026Q3).

We have set out 3 packages below. Each would be an acceptable basis for agreement for us; if none fits, please tell us which term is the hardest for you:
1. EUR 4.35 per unit, payment 14 days net, 24 months
2. EUR 4.36 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months
3. EUR 4.35 per unit, payment 14 days net, 36 months

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part? And what would you need from us to move further on the price?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

sup:70610.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
sup:70610.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
sup:70610.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We appreciate your volume commitment and have factored the verified market index decrease into our revised calculation. 

As a distributor, we cannot provide a detailed cost breakdown, but our pricing accurately reflects current procurement costs; further price movements would require increased volume commitments. Material accounts for about 61 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Our Angebot is a price of €5.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Building on your second package, we propose €5.47 per unit for a 24-month contract with 30 days net payment. 

Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

sup:70610.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
sup:70610.body:
Dear Franz Stadler,

Thank you for moving on the terms; this helps.

We commit to a binding volume of 30000 pieces a year over 24 months, our full need for this part.

Below are 2 packages we could sign. If one term is the obstacle, please name it:
1. EUR 4.51 per unit, payment 14 days net, 24 months
2. EUR 4.52 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24 months

What would you need from us to move further?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

sup:70610.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
sup:70610.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
sup:70610.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for contacting us. We appreciate your revised offer, but your target price remains too low for us to accept. As a dedicated partner, we always strive to find the right solution from our wide product range and offer you the best possible service. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our primary offer is a price of €5.34 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Building on your second package, we can offer €5.35 per unit for a 24-month contract with 30 days net payment. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

To move further, we would need you to share the data behind your volume commitment of 30000 pieces. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? We look forward to your response.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
